FIRST CONFERENCE OF THE LEGALISE CANNABIS ALLIANCE

People with illnesses like multiple sclerosis and arthritis are enduring additional suffering because the law prevents them from growing and using cannabis, a weekend conference in Norwich was told.
See

The first conference of the Legalise Cannabis Alliance called for people to stand at elections across the country this year.

Nominating Officer Alun Buffry said: " People are suffering from everything from MS to awful pains and cannot legally grow a plant and use it for medication. "
See
Marijuana Eases Tremors In Mice " with a condition similar to multiple sclerosis. "

At the conference in Wensum Lodge, Steven Pank said: " Cannabis has to be considered as separate from other so-called dangerous drugs which the Misuse of drugs Act was introduced to deal with. "

Blair to suggest common EU drug sentences

By Mike Peacock

LONDON, March 8 (Reuters) - Prime Minister Tony Blair will use a speech to the Scottish parliament on Thursday to unveil British proposals for European cooperation on drug trafficking, his top aide said.

Britain will suggest at the June summit of European Union heads of state in Feira, Portugal, that the EU should have common minimum sentences for those convicted of dealing in and trafficking drugs.
(MarijuanaNews note: Blair might start at home on harmonizing sentencing. The consequences of getting caught with cannabis varies greatly from one place to another in his own country.)
See
Wide Range Of Consequences For People Caught with Cannabis in UK.
In his first visit to the devolved Scottish parliament set up a year ago, Blair will say that effectively tackling the scourge of illegal drugs requires addressing the issue at every level -- Scottish, British, European and global.

" Dealers and smugglers have to know they face severe penalties wherever they are caught,'' his official spokesman said Blair would say.
See
UK " Gangbusters Are Warning The Government That Going Soft On Cannabis Laws Will Trigger A New Drugs Crisis. "

Britain has a minimum seven-year sentence for traffickers caught for a third time, but sentencing policy varies wildly across the EU.
(MarijuanaNews note: Even the very prohibitionist UK has sentences far lower than DEAland.)

Britain will also suggest that discussions about drugs should start now with countries applying to join the EU, including the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary and Slovenia, Poland and Cyprus.
(MarijuanaNews note: This is a standard prohibitionist ploy, force the countries that want to join the EU or NATO to adopt the disastrous drugs policies of the major EU countries.)
Most heroin coming into Britain originates in Asia, Blair's spokesman said.

" There are various routes and some of them come through applicant countries,'' he said.

But Blair will stress that Britain does not see drugs as a potential block to EU enlargement.

" All our countries have got drug problems. All those countries have drug problems,'' he will say, adding that cross-border problems require cross-border solutions.

After speaking to the Scottish parliament, Blair will visit a drugs rehabilitation project in Glasgow with Britain's drugs czar, Keith Hellawell, who is in charge of the government's anti-drugs programme.

Hellawell, a former police chief, will visit key applicant states soon with a team of experts. He has already talked to officials in Brussels.
See
Blair To Declare War On Cannabis – What Prohibition Is Really All About. War On Half The Youth Of The UK

Blair's spokesman said he would make the announcement in Scotland because of the scale of drugs problems there. Almost 300 Scots die from drug abuse every year.
(MarijuanaNews note: The UK has the worst drugs problem in the EU, so Blair’s giving advice on the issues is a bit much.)
See
Prohibitionist UK Leads Europe In Cannabis Consumption.
More School Children Have Abused Solvents Than In Any Other EU Country.
Following DEAland Policies Gets Them DEAland Results.

He will also say the war on drugs shows the benefits of devolution, that action can be taken in every region but that in the end, the battle would only be won if it was taken up across the world.
